paragraphs: Mentioned at the beginning of Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 6, reporting in the name of Rabbi Berekhiah; Yalkut Tehillim, remez 104 lacks the word Chavra.[^1]

notes.text: רפ״ו gives beginning of chapter 6, not the older 86 or end reading. Exact Midrash Rabbah -- TE Bereshit Rabbah 6:1 names Yosti Chavra reporting in full Rabbi Berekhiah’s name, supporting that title expansion. Chavra remains a designation, and provisional heading status is not newly settled. רמז קד explicitly gives Yalkut Tehillim remez 104; its missing-Chavra observation is Hyman’s comparison, not a fresh Yalkut collation or exhaustive absence claim.
